about: Each Region in physique_schemas.REGIONS -> the free-exercise-db muscle groups the planner trains for it (ADR-039 item 7, ADR-048 section 2). The floor in baselines.json applies per muscle group, so a region with several groups needs every one of them at or above it. Groups use the dataset's own names. `shoulders` is one group (no front/rear split in the dataset), so lateral, front and rear delt work all count toward it.

shoulders.note: Lateral and rear work count toward this single group; heavy secondary credit from chest and triceps work.

upper_back.note: Size is never measured (`measured: false`, ADR-039 item 2); it still gets its baseline volume.

lats.note: Shown as 'back width (estimate)' and unranked, or `measured: false` (ADR-037); it still gets its baseline volume.

waist.note: Trains the abdominal muscle. It does not shrink the waist girth, which follows body fat; the report must not claim it does.

hips.note: Few exercises list abductors as primary (8 of 876); the floor is mostly met through secondary credit.

upper_arm.note: The girth gap covers both muscles; each gets its own floor.

thigh.note: Adductors have few primary exercises (13 of 876); mostly secondary credit.

untracked.lower back: Not tracked, not prescribed directly. The planner does not forbid compound lifts that hit it.
untracked.neck: Not tracked, not prescribed directly. The planner does not forbid compound lifts that hit it.
